cards.label: Shoreditch
cards.text: A back room over a print shop. Des has the kettle on, which usually means the news is bad and he'd like to be holding something.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "One of ours has been paying the Firm. Small amounts, regular. So the Firm leaves their patch alone. They're not selling us out - they're frightened, and they've got a vein and two kids."

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "Everyone knows. That's the problem. Everyone's watching to see what we do about it."
What the Collective does about it.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.result_text: Nobody says anything to them. They keep paying. A few people stop sitting next to Des at meetings, and don't say why.

choices.label: Make an example of them
choices.result_text: It's done loudly, so it gets round. It gets round the Firm as well, who take it personally that someone stopped paying them.

choices.label: Cover their vein instead (£150)
choices.result_text: The Collective puts someone on their patch, paid for properly. They stop paying the Firm the same week. Nadia writes the arrangement down.

cards.text: Des washes the mugs up himself. He doesn't say whether he'd have done it differently.
